svg.title: Designed variation CL-08
svg.desc: पन्थन् “path” | Relation: Lexical paradigm | वैदिक: distributes forms across पन्था, पथि, पथ् differently from laukika and | preserves additional plurals | लौकिक: regularizes the distribution assigned to the three forms | Contribution: open · Evidence: form recorded · question open | Prevalence: 1 paradigm · grade A
